public.title: Meeting Rooms II
public.description: Each interval [start,end] is a meeting occupying start through just before end, with start strictly less than end. Return the minimum rooms needed. Meetings ending at a start time release rooms first. There are 0 to 500 intervals with integer endpoints between 0 and 1000000.
hints: Sort start and end events together.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The peak number of active half-open intervals is the required number of rooms. Process ends before starts at equal times. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
